viewed_note: Sheets 0079-0081 were opened as images just before the account-switch restart and recorded here after it; the notes come from those reads plus two new crops. viewed_utc from date -u. The viewed_utc values typed into batches 001-022 run about 2 h ahead of the clock; the file times are the true record.

sheets.0079: 04_5 72.4-75.817 s. The z^2 title, 'colour cycles around 0: 2', 'zero of order 2' and the 'precisely:' note fade out together (72.4 s), gone at 72.7 s. 73.7 s: the portrait becomes 1/z: red right, violet up, teal left, yellow-green down, so the hue runs the other way round (arg -theta). Title 'f(z) = 1/z' at 74.5 s. 75.817 s: a pink ring marks the pole at 0, a pink-edged 'simple pole' box sits inside the circle, the point is at angle 0 with the legend ray at 0, and 'colour cycles around 0: -1' in pink. Crop crops/s0079-slot8-cycles-minus4x.png: the caption minus is the short heavy text hyphen (L1). No other defect.
sheets.0080: 04_5 76.0-80.9 s. Point and legend ray measured from the stills: point 11.7 deg -> ray -11.3 deg, counter '+0.0' (-0.03 shown as +0.0 rather than -0.0, acceptable); 50.8 deg -> -49 deg, '-0.1' (-0.14); 333.4 deg -> +25.5 deg, '-0.9' (-0.93); 352.3 deg -> +7.6 deg, '-1.0' (-0.98). All consistent with 1/z turning the other way. The counter '-1.0' uses a long TeX minus (crops/s0080-slot4-counter4x.png), unlike the hyphen in the caption beside it. 80.6 s: circle, counter, captions and box fade together; 80.9 s only the portrait and legend remain. No new defect.
sheets.0081: 04_5 end and 04_6 81.0-89.5 s. The 1/z portrait fades to black inside its frame (81.4 s). 84.5 s: title 'f(z) = 1/(1 + z^2)' (TeX fraction, superscript fine) over an empty frame with grey axes and the unit circle. 85.017 s: a violet quiz box under the legend, 'where are the bump's poles? how many turns at each?'; readable lavender on a dark violet fill. Held unchanged to 89.5 s with no answer shown in this sheet. No defect.

findings.text: Recurs in the 04_5 caption 'colour cycles around 0: -1' (short heavy hyphen), f23481-f23768, while the counter '-1.0' beside it (sheet 0080 slot 4, f23714) uses the full-length TeX minus; the two glyphs differ in one frame.
